description: Pull a multi-institution, multi-quarter Call Report panel — one row per institution per quarter — filtered by CERTs, headquarters state, asset range, and thresholds on any catalog metric. Use it to screen (every bank in a state with a noncurrent-loan rate above 3%) or to build a trend panel for SQL. Returns an inline preview sorted as requested; when the panel exceeds the preview it is staged as a dataframe for fdic_dataframe_query. With no dates it covers the latest published quarter only.

certs.description: Up to 100 CERTs to include; omit to screen every filer.

from_date.description: Earliest quarter: a quarter-end date (2024-03-31), the same without dashes, or a quarter label (2024Q1). Omit for to_date alone.

limit.description: Rows returned inline (1–500). A panel with more rows is also staged whole as a dataframe when this deployment stages dataframes.

max_assets.description: Maximum total assets in that quarter, thousands of US dollars; applied to each quarter's report.

metric_filters.description: Up to 5 metric thresholds, all of which a row must meet. A threshold on a capital ratio or insured_deposit_share skips filers that did not report it. Each filtered metric is added to metrics.

items.description: One threshold: a metric with min, max, or both.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound in the metric's unit.

metric.description: Metric name from the catalog, e.g. roa, net_income_ytd, cet1_ratio.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound in the metric's unit: percent for ratios (3 = 3%), thousands of dollars for amounts.

metrics.description: Up to 30 metric names (fdic_list_reference topic metrics) to return. Omit for the default health set.

items.description: Metric name from the catalog, e.g. roa, net_income_ytd, cet1_ratio.

min_assets.description: Minimum total assets in that quarter, thousands of US dollars (1000000 = $1 billion); applied to each quarter's report.

sort_by.description: Metric to order the preview (and the staged table) by; added to metrics when absent. Omit to order by newest quarter, then CERT.

sort_order.description: desc (default, largest first) or asc; applies to sort_by. Rows without a value sort last.

state.description: Headquarters state: two-letter code in any case or full name. Branch locations are in fdic_get_deposits.

to_date.description: Latest quarter, in the same forms as from_date. Omit for the latest published quarter; beside from_date, a later quarter is cut back to it.

name: fdic_query_financials

cap.description: The limit applied to the preview.

data_as_of.description: When FDIC last rebuilt the financials index (ISO timestamp).

dataset.description: The staged full panel; present only when the panel exceeded the preview and this deployment staged it as a dataframe.

row_count.description: Rows staged: the whole fetched panel.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_state`: state is not a US state, DC, or territory code or name. `invalid_date_range`: from_date is after to_date, or the requested quarters (from_date, or to_date alone) start after the latest published quarter. `invalid_metric_filter`: A metric_filters entry has neither min nor max, or min exceeds max. `invalid_asset_range`: min_assets exceeds max_assets. `pacer_shed`: This server's shared FDIC request queue is saturated and the call would wait past its budget. `upstream_rate_limited`: FDIC answered 429 and retries were exhausted. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

metric_definitions.description: Field, unit, and basis of each metric in rows.

items.description: Definition of one metric in the rows.

basis.description: point_in_time = balance at quarter end; quarter = that quarter alone; quarter_annualized = ratio from the quarter, annualized; year_to_date = accumulated since January 1; ytd_annualized = ratio from the year-to-date flow, annualized.

field.description: FDIC Call Report field code the metric maps to, e.g. ROAQ.

metric.description: Catalog metric name, the key it has in each row's values.

note.description: Caveat, such as zero meaning not reported.

notice.description: Guidance for zero matches, a capped panel, or where the full panel is staged.

panel_row_cap.description: This server's row cap for one panel.

panel_truncated.description: True when total_matching exceeded the panel row cap. Whole quarters are kept newest first, so a truncated panel is missing its oldest quarters — or, when the newest quarter alone exceeds the cap, the higher-numbered CERTs of that quarter.

to.description: Latest quarter-end covered (YYYY-MM-DD), never past the latest published quarter.

report_dates_defaulted.description: True when neither from_date nor to_date was given, so only the latest published quarter was covered.

rows.description: Inline preview of the panel, sorted as requested.

name.description: Name as filed on the Call Report for the quarter.

values.description: Metric name → value in that metric's unit (see metric_definitions); null when not reported.

total_matching.description: Institution-quarter rows at FDIC matching the filters.

truncated.description: True when the preview holds fewer rows than were fetched.

title: Query a multi-bank financial panel
